blurb: Yonder Yoga provides infrared-heated power yoga classes including vinyasa flows, hip-hop flow, foundations flow, candlelit yin, yin-yang flow, and advanced flow. Classes are designed for all levels and focus on physical and mental health through breath-paced sequencing and alignment. The studio offers amenities such as showers, lockers, towel rentals, and complimentary mat rentals.
extraNote: 4-hour cancellation policy with $15 late cancel fee and $20 no-show fee · Late cancel fees waived if reservation moved to another class same day at least 1 hour before class · No late arrivals or early departures allowed
